programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: Chicago, 1930s. At the request of Frankenstein (Christian Bale), researcher Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening) resurrects for him a woman (Jessie Buckley), a murder victim, pulled out of the grave.An odd couple like Bonny and Clyde quickly attracts trouble and has to flee the city.Detective Jake (Peter Sarsgaard) follows them, with his assistant Myrna (Penelope Cruz) helping him at every step.The revived dead woman and her companion cause chaos wherever they appear.Together they commit robberies and murders, and over time, the two outcasts develop a fiery romance.Mary Shelley, possessed by the voice of the writer, seeks destruction, but at the same time frees herself from the corset of social conventions.An ambitious reinterpretation of a horror classic with elements of Victorian horror and burlesque.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Year 1950, Mexico.William Lee (Daniel Craig), a middle-aged American, spends his days almost alone.He contacts several people from a small American community of students and bar owners.The arrival of another student, Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey), in town makes him realize for the first time that an intimate bond is possible.The men first become friends, then their relationship turns into a romance.As a couple, they go to South America in search of a drug that supposedly gives the power of telepathy.

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that people are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programme.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, a meteorite falls on the zoo.Thanks to him, some of the inhabitants turn into neon, jelly-like creatures with suspicious properties, and the entire zoo is thrown into chaos.The clever wolf Gracie and the haughty puma Dan, who have been out of each other's way until now, decide to put aside their personal grudges to save the animals.Together with a group of daredevils, including Frida the capybara, Felix the baboon, Ash the nervous ostrich, Xavier the lemur and the charming Hippo, they create a crazy rescue team.The Polish language version was attended by, among others:Magdalena Boczarska, Marcin Piętowski and Mateusz Banasiuk.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The ninja turtles defeated their eternal enemy Shredder and each of them found a different job.Michaelangelo makes money at children's parties as a mascot.Donatello works as a telephone operator, and Leonardo exercises his character in solitude.Only Raphael remained faithful to his old ideals and fights hooligans at night.Meanwhile, Master Splinter begins to see signs of impending danger.Immortal entrepreneur, Maximilian J. Winters decides to take control of New York, and later the entire world.To do this, he summons his four stone generals and tries to open the gate to another dimension.Only a team of Teenage Mutant Turtles can stop him.

programme.title: Tempete
programme.desc: Zoe (Carmen Kassovitz) grew up surrounded by horses in her parents' (Mélanie Laurent and Pio Marmai) racing stable.This is her place on earth.He dreams of one day becoming a jockey like his father.When a new foal is born, the girl is the first to notice its potential to become a champion.The family's life changes one tragic night, when a scared mare accidentally injures Zoe.The teenager, overcome with despair, completely breaks down.Thanks to the support of her parents and the help of the stable boy (Kacey Mottet Klein), who has an extraordinary gift for communicating with horses, Zoe decides to overcome adversity and regain what seemed lost.

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: The intertwined adventures of several women who are looking for happiness and fulfillment at different stages of life.Magda (Marta Nieradkiewicz) tries to reconcile raising children and running a home with her professional ambitions.Distrustful Basia (Marta Ścisłowicz) avoids love, even though she wants it very much.Krysia (Hanna Śleszyńska), a married woman for 30 years, tries to arouse a bit of enthusiasm in the bored and apathetic Władek (Olaf Lubaszenko).Businesswoman Agata (Katarzyna Herman) is successful at work, but cannot find a common language with her daughter.Julia (Kamila Urzędowska) tries to make it in an industry that values ​​only youth and beauty.She discovers how much she will have to sacrifice.Polish remake of the German comedy "Wunderschön" from 2022.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Police officers Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs are assigned to a dangerous mission.They are busting a gang of drug smugglers, led by a man named Montoya.The trafficker is believed to be involved in the murder of two federal agents and the family of their informant.Crockett and Tubbs infiltrate the Montoi organization.Sonny begins an affair with Isabella, who invests the proceeds of crime in legal ventures.Crockett tries to protect his lover, having no idea what the woman actually does and what her true identity is.Meanwhile, Tubbs and his girlfriend, analyst Trudy Joplin, try to understand the activities of criminals using their own methods.Ricardo does not know that he is putting his beloved in danger.Wanting to reach the gang leader, two detectives decide to transport a load of drugs to southern Florida.Gradually, the lines between the rules of the underworld and the rule of law are blurring.

programme.title: Locke
programme.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with the progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.

credits.actor: Schack Carl Rantzau - Thomas W. Gabrielsson
J. H. E. Bernstoff - Bent Mejding
Augusta - Princess of Wales - Harriet Walter

programme.title: Singing In My Sleep
programme.desc: Musically talented Charlotte (Jessica Belkin) follows in the footsteps of her father, a legendary singer whom she never met.The artist abandoned his family when she was a child.Supported by her mother, the teenager writes lyrics, composes and presents her works on the Internet.One day, she is asked to participate in a party celebrating the 20th anniversary of the release of her father's debut album.The surprised girl must decide whether to celebrate the event of a parent who did not participate in her upbringing, and the only souvenir he left behind was a song.

programme.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Tehran.Lawyer Iman (Missagh Zareh) is promoted to the position of investigating judge, which brings both financial benefits and a higher social status to his family, as well as a number of restrictive rules and obligations.Gradually, the man discovers the dark side of his new role - he is to approve death sentences for activists without fair trials.His nomination coincides with street protests following the death of a young woman detained by the police.The atmosphere in Iman's house becomes tense.The daughters, Rezvan (Mahsa Rostami) and Sana (Setareh Maleki), previously absorbed in school and friendships, begin to rebel more and more boldly against their father and the authority he represents and justifies.Najmeh's mother (Soheila Golestani) tries to calm the conflict.The situation becomes dramatic when Iman's service weapon disappears from his drawer... A moving story about the ethical dilemmas of ordinary people trapped in the gears of an authoritarian system.

credits.actor: Woman in car - Amineh Mazrouie Arani

programme.title: The A List: 15 Stories From Asian And Pacific Diasporas
programme.desc: Actors, activists, athletes and influential Asian Americans participate in a series of intimate interviews.In front of the camera were, among others:Sandra Oh and Kumail Nanjiani.

programme.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programme.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: The year 2142. The Jackson's Star mining colony was established on the distant planet LV-410.The workers include orphaned Rain (Cailee Spaeny) and Andy (David Jonsson), a robot reprogrammed by her father.The girl wants to escape to a better world, but her forced labor contract is extended by the corporation.Together with his brother android, he joins the rebels who discovered that there is an abandoned research station hovering over the planet.The fugitives get aboard and discover cryogenic chambers, thanks to which they can make a long interplanetary journey.However, they do not know that there is also a bloodthirsty beast on the ship that they will have to face.A continuation of the famous SF horror series, well received by critics and viewers.The action takes place between the events of "Alien - 8th Passenger of the Nostromo" by Ridley Scott and "Alien - The Decisive Engagement" by James Cameron.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Trolls are cheerful, singing and fabulously colorful creatures that live in a colorful forest.None of them have any idea what the world around them is like.Poppy displays their positive attitude the most.Her carefreeness and joy is shared by everyone, except Mruk.The troll believes that his brethren are in danger.These words come true when the village of nice creatures is found by their greatest enemies, the Bergens.All of Poppy's friends are kidnapped and she must set out to rescue them.She is accompanied by Mruk, who is reluctant to leave his house.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Magdalena Wasylik, Piotr Bajtlik, Ewa Konstancja Bułhak and Bartosz Obuchowicz.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: British ski jumper Michael 'Eddie' Edwards, although not successful, believes in his abilities.Thanks to the help of a charismatic coach, in 1988 he took part in the Olympics in Calgary.

credits.actor: Richmond the BOA Official - Mark Benton

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: DJ Ahmet
programme.desc: In the Macedonian village of Yuruk, the inhabitants live in accordance with tradition.Young people quickly start families and go on their own.15-year-old Ahmet (Arif Jakup) usually looks after sheep and takes care of his younger brother, but he loves electronic music and would like to become a DJ.To the dismay of his father and the conservative community, he equips his tractor with a sound system.His path crosses with a fellow dancer, Aya, who also dreams of a different life.The girl will soon get married according to her parents' decision.Together they decide to organize a party - as a rebellious act of freedom and self-expression.The feature debut of a creator from North Macedonia, who turned out to be one of the winners of Sundance in 2025.It's a touching story about growing up in a place where techno and tradition do not go hand in hand.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

credits.actor: reporter na konferencji prasowej - Andrew Secunda

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: 1960s.Young Briton Jude (Jim Sturgess) goes to the United States in search of his father, whom he has never known before.The man is said to be a university lecturer.However, he turns out to be an ordinary worker.There, Jude meets a teenage American girl, Lucy (Evan Rachel Wood).They both fall in love with each other at first sight.Soon, Lucy's brother, Max (Joe Anderson), is drafted and goes to war in Vietnam.Meanwhile, Jude and Lucy, along with a group of friends and musicians, engage in anti-war activities.Their guides are: Dr. Robert (Bono) and Mr. Kite (Eddie Izzard).Together they fight for freedom of speech and civil rights.However, the tense situation is not favorable for lovers.Adversity tears them apart.They have to overcome many obstacles to be together again.The film's soundtrack included several songs by the legendary band The Beatles.The film was nominated for a Golden Globe (Best Musical) and an Oscar (Best Costume Design).

programme.title: I.S.S
programme.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: A group of criminals breaks into a perfectly secured mansion.Their goal is to kidnap twelve-year-old ballerina Abigail (Alisha Weir).The bandits transport a hostage, for whom a ransom of $50 million has been set, to Lambert (Giancarlo Esposito).She is to spend the night in an isolated residence.The kidnappers guarding her disappear one by one.The truth about who they were locked up with finally comes to light.The inconspicuous-looking victim is not as defenseless as it may seem.An unusual variation on the vampire motif.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) is plagued by nightmares about her grandparents.In their dreams, they die along with other people in the Skyview skyscraper in 1969.Although such an event never happened, the girl decides to investigate the cause of her visions.To do this, he returns to his hometown, Cloverdale.She is greeted there by her father, Marty (Tinpo Lee), and younger brother, Charlie (Teo Briones).Stefani begins searching for Iris (Brec Bassinger), the grandmother she sees in her nightmares and who has broken off contact with her family.To do this, he visits his Uncle Howard (Alex Zahara) and Aunt Brenda (April Telek).Thanks to the letters found among them, he reaches a woman (Gabrielle Rose) who is dying of cancer and lives in a remote area.She tells her that the skyscraper did not collapse only thanks to her vision and earlier intervention.At the same time, he warns that from that day on, death has haunted everyone who died in the disaster, and even the descendants of the would-be victims.As she dies, her words quickly come true.Stefani wants to save her relatives from the gruesome death that inevitably awaits them.The sixth installment of the series launched in 2000.

programme.title: Den sidste viking
programme.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programme.title: By sleeping with others

programme.title: The Royal Hotel
programme.desc: Two American friends, Hanna (Julia Garner) and Liv (Jessica Henwick), decide to travel around Australia this summer.Unfortunately, at some point they run out of money.Women need to find temporary work.Their choice falls on a provincial mining settlement, where there is the only local bar called "The Royal Hotel".They quickly manage to adapt to the unusual atmosphere of this place, although this requires developing a specific strategy.Soon they are faced with a situation over which they lose control.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: Clover and her friends go to the valley where her sister disappeared.They become the target of a murderer.Their story repeats itself every morning.

programme.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.Devastated, Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.

programme.title: Little Emma
programme.desc: A little girl named Emma was raised by animals.Her life is full of warmth and joy until one of her friends discovers the unpleasant truth that she was actually adopted and is not part of their family.Devastated, Emma sets out on a journey to find her loved ones.Along the way, he gathers an extraordinary team, including the clumsy inventor Żółwik Bystrzak, the ambitious scientist Edward Wilk and the brave Weasel Sancho.Together they are looking for a mysterious island which, according to legend, is inhabited by tiny people.

programme.title: Peasants
programme.desc: In Lipce, life goes according to the rhythm of nature.Maciej Boryna, the richest man in the village, decides to take Jagna as his wife.Although the girl prefers colorful clothes and paper cutouts to working in the fields, and there are numerous rumors about her reputation, she cannot resist the temptation.He strikes a deal with Dominikowa, who agrees to marry his daughter to him.Soon there is a grand wedding.However, the bride is not happy.He loves his stepson, Antek, with reciprocity, which quickly becomes clear to his wife Hanka.Boryna's son is not only constantly looking for an opportunity to meet his stepmother, but also, taking pride in his honor, condemns the family to vegetation.Subsequent dramatic events cause the entire community's resentment against Jagna to turn into open hostility.

programme.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
programme.desc: 23-year-old guitarist Scott Pilgrim (Michael Cera) living in Toronto begins dating seventeen-year-old Knives (Ellen Wong).However, he soon meets the antipathetic Ramona Flowers (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), with whom he immediately falls in love.Regardless of anything, he decides to win the heart of the pink-haired stranger.To do this, he must deal with her seven exes, including:popular actor and skateboarder Lucas Lee (Chris Evans), vegan Todd Ingram (Brandon Routh) with extraordinary powers and musician Matthew Patel (Satya Bhabha).His task is made even more difficult by the rejected Knives, who is desperately trying to get her boyfriend back.The picture is based on the comic book series "Scott Pilgrim" by Canadian artist Bryan Lee O'Malley.The title character was played by Michael Cera, known from "Juno" and "Superbad".

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programme.title: Bastarden
programme.desc: Year 1755, Denmark.The impoverished Captain Ludvig (Mads Mikkelsen) asks the king for permission to establish a colony on his behalf on the barren moors famous for their infertility.If successful, he expects to be awarded a knighthood and property.The aristocrats are outraged by his arrogance and assume defeat, but he receives consent.From then on, every day for Ludvig and his relatives is spent on hard, physical work beyond their strength, which will allow them to prepare the land for cultivation.They also hire people to help them - two runaway servants: Ann Barbara (Amanda Collin) and her husband.Months pass and the first buildings are built when the ruthless Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg), the land lord, tries to take over the moors.When Ludvig rejects his offer, he decides to destroy it.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

A slightly lost, nice Englishman, Newt Scamander, returns from an international research expedition, during which he had to find and describe as many species of fantastic animals as possible.He is carrying a mysterious suitcase with unknown contents.On the way he stops in New York.America is different from his homeland.It is forbidden to possess or transport magical creatures.Newt gets into trouble when it comes to light that his briefcase contains creatures considered dangerous.A researcher who is aware of their uniqueness does everything to ensure that they do not become extinct.Due to his inattention, several peculiar specimens find their way into the real world.Even more chaos is caused by a powerful force that threatens people's lives.Mr. Graves tries to erase the memories of people who witness her actions.The Muggle Jakub becomes involved in the course of events.Scamander must control the situation as quickly as possible and discover the source of the problem.

programme.desc: Preparations for the elections for the President of the United States are underway.Selina is determined to win it.The most dangerous rival turns out to be his former colleague, Jonah.

programme.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programme.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her fateful fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Teenage Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), from New Jersey to Los Angeles.He becomes friends with his peer Tommy (Rob Garrison).During a beach party, the boy meets a nice blonde, Ali (Elisabeth Shue).The two immediately take a liking to each other, which does not please her ex-boyfriend, Johnny (William Zabka).As an excellent karateka, he easily teaches his rival a lesson.Humiliated, Daniel also decides to start training eastern martial arts to defeat the enemy.Unfortunately, he cannot join the local club because Johnny and his equally unpleasant and brutal friends practice there.One evening, Daniel is attacked by them again.He is saved from trouble by an old man, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), who turns out to be a master of eastern martial arts.From then on, the teenager learns the secrets of karate under his watchful eye.The Japanese teaches him not only the fighting style, but also a lot about life... A perfect film for karate lovers.For his role as Master Noriyuki "Pat" Morita, he received an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Golden Globe nomination.Director of photography John G. Avildsen is known as the creator of the legendary "Rocky" from 1976 with Sylvester Stallone.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spencer (Alex Wolff) is not feeling well at college in New York and is losing confidence again.During the Christmas break spent at home, he reaches for the console to return to the adventurous world of Jumanji.To save him, Martha (Morgan Turner), Bethany (Madison Iseman) and Fridge (Ser'Darius Blain) immediately spring into action.However, it turns out that the rules of the game have changed a lot.They cannot take on their former avatars and must switch roles.Soon, as the adventurer Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), the warrior Ruby Roundhouse (Karen Gillan), the Mouse (Kevin Hart) and the frightened Professor Sheldon Oberon (Jack Black) go deep not only into the jungle, but also into endless deserts and dangerous mountain ranges.They face many threats and a certain cunning villain (Rory McCann).Continuation of "Jumanji: Adventure in the Jungle" from 2017.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title Joel and Ellie wander through a desolate forest area.The man finds it difficult to come to terms with Tess's death.He still doesn't accept the teenager's company.Together they reach the empty building where Joel hid supplies years ago.The next destination of their trip is Bill and Frank's fortress.The year 2003. Survivalist Bill is hiding in his house.When the army deports all the inhabitants of his town, they surround the area with barbed wire, install traps for the infected and stockpile supplies.Four years later, a hungry wanderer, Frank, reaches him.Since the man is not infected, it is agreed to feed him.Ultimately, Frank stays in Bill's house for many years.The two start working with smugglers Tess and Joel.

programme.desc: Dr. Amy Larsen, former chief of internal medicine, is rebuilding her life after a tragic accident that left her with no memory.Now she is an intern.Her past still haunts me.

programme.title: The Outrun
programme.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: The year is 1957. Former friends from their youth, Frank Costello (Robert De Niro) and Vito Genovese (Robert De Niro), are now the most famous New York bosses, fighting for control of the city streets.When one day the first of them becomes the target of a failed assassination attempt by his rival, he decides it's time to step aside.He informs Vita about this, but he - a man paranoid about losing power - does not believe him.Soon he orders another attack.His victim is Albert Anastazja (Michael Rispoli), appointed by Frank as his successor.This event makes Costell realize that if he does not stop his rival, he will again attempt to kill both him and his loved ones.The conflict between two former friends and now rivals escalates, leading to a dramatic climax.A film inspired by real events.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Recidivist Callum Lynch sentenced to death is not executed.After a fake execution, he ends up in a secret laboratory.There he meets Rikkin and his daughter Sofia.Scientists have a mysterious device that allows them to access the records of ancestors' actions stored in their genes.The criminal is to connect with the consciousness of Aguilar from Spain, who lived during the Great Inquisition and obtained the Apple of Eden, which provides control over emotions.By using this item, you can supposedly eliminate aggression in people.The daredevil travels to the Middle Ages.He discovers that he is a descendant of a member of the Assassin secret society.Over time, he learns what a big mistake he made when he trusted Sofia and her father.

programme.title: Minecraft
programme.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programme.title: First Man
programme.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programme.title: L'amica geniale
programme.desc: Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante On the island of Ischia, Elena hosts her elementary school teacher's cousin, Mrs. Olivero.There, she accidentally crosses paths with the Sarratore family, who are vacationing on the island.She is delighted because she has the opportunity to spend more time with Nino, whom she has been in love with for a long time.Elena also has a chance to get closer to the boy's family: the charismatic father Donato with a friendly nature, Lidia who is blindly in love with her husband, and Nino's sister Marisa.Elena notices that Nino is completely different from the other members of the Sarratore family, and she often treats them with dislike.However, Elena still strives to spend as much time with him as possible.During an evening together on the beach, the young people start kissing.The idyll is interrupted by Lila, who calls Elena for help.She is increasingly harassed by the stubborn Marcello Solara, who has chosen her as his wife.A devoted friend wants to return home as soon as possible.On her fifteenth birthday, Nino's father persuades Elena to extend her stay, and later at night he grabs her in his arms and starts kissing her incessantly.In the morning Elena leaves.

programme.title: Red One
programme.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: The Hobbit Frodo Baggins comes into possession of a magical Ring.His relative Bilbo obtained it during his expedition to the Lonely Mountain.This extraordinary gem can give its owner control over the world, which is why its creator - the Lord of Darkness Sauron - will do anything to get it back.The wizard Gandalf knows that the Ring must be destroyed.There is only one way to do this - by throwing him into the fire that burns inside Mount Doom.However, getting there is very difficult.A council is called in Rivendell on this matter.Frodo undertakes a dangerous mission to destroy the jewel.He is accompanied by his friendly hobbits, Sam Gamgee and Pippin and Merry, as well as representatives of other races: the elf Legolas, the dwarf Gimli, people - Aragorn and Boromir - and Gandalf.The ring has a sinister power that is difficult to avoid.It arouses strong desire and influences the psyche, which puts the team to the test.Meanwhile, Sauron sends his troops against her.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: The Pitt
programme.desc: Santos investigates how Langdon prescribes drugs to his regular patient Louie Cloverfield.Rita wakes up in the car.He returns to duty immediately.A patient with a severed finger flirts with Collins.The team fails to save Amber, a 6-year-old drowning victim.Javadi diagnoses a spider bite.The symptoms were mistaken for Crohn's disease.Nick's parents finally agree to the transplant.McKay suspects Piper may be a victim of human trafficking.He and Dana try to help her.Mel has difficulty with Bella.Robby informs Willie of Adamson's death.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mysterious plague turns most people into bloodthirsty zombies.Only a few manage to avoid infection.This lucky group includes a clumsy and clumsy Columbus student.The boy is afraid of almost everything.The prospect of living in a world overrun by beasts terrifies him.Meanwhile, his friend, the brave Tallahassee, is excited about the whole situation.He is a tough guy who intends to single-handedly kill every monster that stands in his way.The men must fight the monsters together.They can count on the help of the sisters - Wichita and Little Rock.The girls try to alleviate the tense atmosphere between the men.For them, enduring each other's company is as difficult as getting rid of zombies.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Ten years have passed since Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson), Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg), Wichita (Emma Stone) and Little Rock (Abigail Breslin) decided to face a world full of the living dead together.It seemed that they knew everything about zombies and knew how to deal with them.Over time, however, bloodthirsty creatures managed to evolve and spread throughout the country.Four heroes must face a new threat.The problems are mounting, and there are typical family conflicts between them.On their way, they also meet other survivors.Sequel to "Zombieland" from 2009.This is another collaboration between Jesse Eisenberg and Woody Harrelson - they met, among others,on the set of two parts of "Illusion".A mixture of chocolate and coffee was used to create realistic-looking blood - the main actors agreed that it tasted like chemicals and they would not like to play zombie characters who had this fake blood in their mouths and on their teeth.

programme.title: Undercurrent: The Disappearance of Kim Wall
programme.desc: The story of the murder of Swedish reporter Kim Wall, which took place in August 2017.As the investigation revealed, famous inventor Peter Madsen lured a woman into an underwater boat that he built himself.During a cruise along the coast of Copenhagen, Wall was to interview the designer.When she did not return, a search began which revealed the shocking truth.The case of the journalist's death also draws attention to the issue of women's safety in the modern world.Wall received specialized training to prepare her for various work situations.Despite this, she died in a theoretically safe place.

programme.title: The List
programme.desc: Matt is cheating on his fiancée Abby with a celebrity from the "exceptions to monogamy" list.The hurt woman decides to pay him back in kind.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Antarctica.Mambo was born in a land famous for penguins with vocal talent.Singing gives them a sense of community and cements relationships.Unfortunately, Mambo does not have this ability.His mother Norma Jean sees nothing wrong with it, but Memphis' father fears for the future of his son who, due to his inability, may never find his soul mate.The penguin has another valuable gift - he can tap dance perfectly.However, this is not enough for his friend Gloria, the best singer in the area and the leader of the Penguin Empire, who banishes Mamba.He thinks that he doesn't fit in with the rest of the herd.While traveling alone, the exile encounters alien penguins.They are delighted with his tap dancing ability and invite him to their land.There, the penguin discovers a very important truth in life, which says that being yourself is the most important thing.An excellent family film, awarded with an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programme.desc: The Fellowship of the Ring has been broken.Frodo and Sam continue their journey to Mordor - the only place where the Ring can be destroyed.They manage to capture Gollum, one of the previous owners of the magical gem.Frodo decides to trust him.She makes him her guide.Meanwhile, Gandalf the Gray fights the Balrog, the Demon of Power.After the duel, the wizard is reborn as Gandalf the White.He joins Aragorn, Legolas the elf and Gimli the dwarf as they journey to Rohan.They must warn the local ruler Théoden about the war.It turns out that he can no longer rule.His faith and strength were robbed by a curse cast by Saruman.Merry and Pippin escape from orc captivity to Fangorn - an ancient forest.Treebeard, the shepherd of trees, takes care of them there.Middle-earth is threatened by great danger - Sauron, ruler of Mordor, and the wizard Saruman, lord of Isengard, unite their forces.Troops of wild Uruk-hai are growing in strength.The day of the Battle of Helm's Deep is approaching.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time marijuana dealer David Clark tries to help teenagers living in his neighborhood.He is attacked by three homeless punks and robbed of his goods and cash.As a result, he becomes indebted to his supplier, Brad Gurdlinger.To repay the debt, he must import the latest batch of stimulants from Mexico.To conceal himself, he arranges helpers to pretend to be his immediate family going on holiday with him.So David's neighbors go on the road with him: cynical stripper Rose O'Reilly, the drug dealer's would-be client, the dim-witted Kenny Rossmore, and the smart, street-savvy teenager Casey Mathis.A laugh-out-loud action movie full of well-acted episodes and indecent gags.This is another joint project of Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston, after the comedies "Get Your Ex" and "Horrible Bosses".

programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.sub-title: Independent shippers compete with each other to transport unconventional items that other carriers find unfeasible to ship
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase \"free shipping\" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

programme.desc: This reality series teams up master mechanic Steve \"Pitbull\" Trimboli with Leepu, a renowned car designer from Bangladesh. Together, their expertise has created a lucrative business. Each episode features a customer with a small budget, an interesting story, and a heap of metal that's special to him or her. Leepu and Pitbull's task is to turn the clunker into a cool custom automobile. The guys sometimes have a difference of opinion on ways to complete each job, but they ultimately make each customer happy, which is key to running a successful business.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Jang Youngsil: The Greatest Scientist Of Joseon
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu
programme.desc: This series follows Lakha, Bablu and Dablu on brand-new wildadventures. Pine Tree Mountain has become a preserve that drawsvisitors from all around to see its natural beauty and wildlife.

programme.title: Fury Spinner
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Shrunk
programme.desc: This series follows Lakha, Bablu and Dablu on brand-new wild adventures. Pine Tree Mountain has become a preserve that draws visitors from all around to see its natural beauty and wildlife. This wildlife now includes some new but familiar residents: Hugo and friends from the hit movie, The Big Top Secret!

programme.title: Cindrella
programme.desc: Young Cinderella, struggling with abuse from her stepmother and stepsisters, receives help from her fairy godmother and animal friends while finding adventure and romance with a dashing man who hides the fact that he is a prince.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster Paln
programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu-Spring Into Action
programme.desc: The forest animals love trees, flowers and spring. So it's up to the bear brothers to stop Logger Vick from chopping down every tree.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Wild Cats of India
programme.desc: A two-part documentary directed by photographer and filmmaker Sandesh Kadur, winner of the 2017 BAFTA award for his work on the program "Planet Earth 2".Wild cats have been considered a symbol of strength and royal power in India since ancient times.There are various species of them in this country.Viewers will learn the secret life of these fascinating animals.The creators of the document will pay special attention to lesser-known representatives of wild cats.Among them will be the Pallas cat, a small predatory mammal with short and massive legs found in Asia.Viewers will also learn about the spotted cat, which is protected by the Washington Convention.This species occurs, among others, in tropical forests and swamps, and to catch prey it jumps into the water.The clouded leopard, which feeds on monkeys and birds, is also a highly endangered species.These cats can, among other things, run headfirst down a tree In 2023, India will become the most populous country in the world, overtaking China in this respect.In addition to the growing human population, numerous wild cats have lived here for centuries.They are elusive and agile.They can avoid human settlements while enjoying the benefits of such a neighborhood.Filmmaker Sandesh Kadur has embarked on a mission to bring Indian cats closer to home.The two-part documentary portrays animals in their natural environment.A particular challenge was to capture the small steppe manulas, which are masters of camouflage.The gray spirit of the Himalayas The hero of the first part of the documentary is an snow leopard living in the land of eternal snow in the Himalayas.There are currently only about 4,000 individuals of this species living in the world.To survive in extremely hostile conditions, the snow leopard must master the art of hunting.The real treat is animals bred by shepherds from a nearby village.The leopard has the largest range of all large cat species.The crevices in the rocks of southwestern Rajasthan are an ideal hiding place for raising offspring.Viewers will witness a fierce duel between the mother leopard and the intruder.They will also see the last refuge of Asiatic lions and the kingdom of impressive Bengal tigresses.

programme.title: Animal fights
programme.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Hoping to escape from his troubled past, former DEA agent Phil Broker moves to a seemingly quiet backwater town in the bayou with his daughter. However, he finds anything but quiet there, for the town is riddled with drugs and violence. When Gator Bodine, a sociopathic drug lord, puts the newcomer and his young daughter in harm's way, Broker is forced back into action to save her and their home. Based on a novel by Chuck Logan.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: A former government operative comes out of retirement and uses all his extensive training to rescue his estranged daughter from a slave trade operation.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Malaysia.There he meets with members of the Badjao community, which the rest of the world has not yet heard of.According to legends, their ancestors had gills.Currently, these people can stay underwater for several minutes on one breath and dive to a depth of 20-30 meters without any specialized equipment.The Badjao live on boats or in houses built on stilts.They spend their whole lives there, so when they come ashore, they get land sickness.Their children learn to swim before they can even walk.The traveler visits a local healer, Djirajniha, who enjoys great trust and respect.Thanks to it, Martyna Wojciechowska can get to know the extraordinary world of Badjao.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Mongolia.There, in the inaccessible mountain areas of Altai, the Kazakh minority lives.They are cut off from their roots, but they maintain traditions from 3,000 years ago.The traveler meets a fourteen-year-old girl with strength and courage greater than many men.Petite, charming Akhbota practices falconry every day after school.It's hard to believe that such a delicate girl can communicate with a predatory bird weighing eight kilograms and whose wingspan reaches up to two meters.Martyna Wojciechowska tells a story about true strength, courage and the bond between man and animal.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: There are still places where education remains a luxury that many children can only dream of.These include Bangladesh - a small country in South Asia, one of the most densely populated and poorest in the world.An area twice as large as Poland is inhabited by as many as 170 million people.At the same time, 20% of the population lives below the poverty line.Obtaining an education gives you a chance to improve your financial situation.Unfortunately, the monsoons that hit Bangladesh every year cut off 1/4 of its area from the rest of the world, including schools.To help thousands of children, squares, libraries and educational centers were created... on boats.He studies there, among others:Rabija, the youngest heroine of Martyna Wojciechowska's program so far.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Country music is a key part of American culture.Thanks to contemporary artists such as Taylor Swift and Beyonce, the genre is attracting new generations of listeners.During his visit to Nashville, Marcin Prokop tries to understand what makes country more than just music.He meets with the artists' agent, visits an independent music studio where he observes a recording session, and talks to the curator of the legendary Ryman Auditorium.He also discovers a unique Polish exhibit in a private automotive museum.During his journey, he meets Tomek Wosiak, an emigrant from Gdynia, a renowned chef and manager of popular restaurants in the USA, who cooperates with the biggest stars.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Country music is a key part of American culture.Thanks to contemporary artists such as Taylor Swift and Beyonce, the genre is attracting new generations of listeners.During his visit to Nashville, Marcin Prokop tries to understand what makes country more than just music.He meets with the artists' agent, visits an independent music studio where he observes a recording session, and talks to the curator of the legendary Ryman Auditorium.He also discovers a unique Polish exhibit in a private automotive museum.During his journey, he meets Tomek Wosiak, an emigrant from Gdynia, a renowned chef and manager of popular restaurants in the USA, who cooperates with the biggest stars.

programme.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Claire (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Sexpot Shelley Darlington (Anna Faris) lives comfortably at the Playboy Mansion, until a jealous rival gets her tossed out on her tail. With nowhere else to go, she winds up at Zeta Alpha Zeta sorority. The seven socially inept Zetas will lose their house unless they can attract more pledges; to do that, they need to learn the ways of makeup and men from an expert.
